claims.s: The Highland Council has received an application for alterations and a public visitor facility at Freewing Masts on Clachnaharry Road, Inverness.
Written comments can be made within 21 days.
Written comments can be made within 28 days.
The application is to demolish a listed building on Clachnaharry Road.
Koehler Renewable Energy UK Limited has applied for consent to build a wind farm and battery storage system near Barrock, east of Thurso.
Representations should be received by 9 November 2026.
The wind farm would have a capacity of about 100 MW.
The turbines would be up to 149.9 metres to blade tip.
The Highland Council has received supplementary environmental information for a wind farm of up to 6 turbines near Drumnadrochit.
Comments must be received within 30 days of the notice.
The wind farm would operate for 25 years.
Printed copies of the supplementary information cost £100.
Additional environmental information has been provided for a development of 100 homes at Inchgarth Road, Cults.
Representations about the environmental statement can be made within 30 days.
The development is for 250 homes.
A hard copy of the environmental statement costs £25.

authority: Secretary of State for Energy Security and Net Zero

claims.s: BP has submitted draft decommissioning programmes for the Andrew topsides and jacket in the Central North Sea.
Representations should be submitted by the consultation closing date of 13 October 2026.
The Andrew field is about 50 km from the UK coast.
The decommissioning programmes were submitted to the Scottish Ministers.
Blackwood Wind Farm Limited has applied for consent for a wind farm of five turbines near New Cumnock.
Representations should be received by 30 November 2026.
The wind farm would have an installed capacity of about 55 MW.
A hard copy of the EIA Report costs £1,500.
The Secretary of State has made an order stopping up parts of Royle Fold and South George Street at Heckmondwike Bus Station.
A challenge to the order can be made to the High Court within 6 weeks from 8 October 2026.
The order stops up highways in the Borough of Calderdale.
Copies of the order cost £10.

authority: Council of the City of Wakefield
THE COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF WAKEFIELD

claims.s: Wakefield Council has made an order to make its whole district a smoke control area, subject to confirmation by the Secretary of State.
The occupier of a building whose chimney emits smoke could face a civil penalty of up to £300.
The order will come into operation one month after it is confirmed.
Objections can be made within four weeks.
Leeds City Council will apply to Kirklees Magistrates Court on 23 October 2026 to stop up part of Willis Street.
The council says the section of highway is unnecessary.
The section of highway covers about 1,000 square metres.
The hearing will be at Leeds Magistrates Court.
The Welsh Ministers propose a permanent 40 mph speed limit on part of the A487 at Newport, Pembrokeshire.
Objections must be sent by 4 November 2026.
The proposed speed limit is 30 mph.
The documents can be inspected at Cardigan Library.
The Welsh Ministers propose to stop up a length of highway south of Capel Zion, Burwen, Amlwch.
Objections must be sent by 8 October 2026.
The stopping up is to allow a new supermarket to be built.
The draft order can be inspected at Holyhead Library.
Temporary restrictions on water use in the Mid and South Ceredigion water resource zone were lifted on 4 September 2026.
The restrictions had been in force since 19 July 2026.
The restrictions remain in force until further notice.
The restrictions applied across the whole of Wales.
National Highways proposes to permanently close gaps in the central reservation of the A47 at Lowestoft, including the gap opposite Jay Lane.
Objections should be sent no later than 6 November 2026 or within 3 weeks of publication, whichever is later.
The gaps would be closed temporarily for six months.
The proposed order can be inspected at Great Yarmouth Library.
National Highways intends to impose a 30 mph speed restriction on the A1 between Sandy Roundabout and Tempsford Junction overbridge.
The variation order would come into force on 15 November 2026.
The speed restriction would be 40 mph.
The restriction would apply only at night.
Norfolk County Council proposes to close part of Dibden Road in Norwich temporarily for building development works.
The road will be closed from 21 September 2026 to 17 October 2028.
The closure ends on 17 October 2027.
Pedestrian access will be stopped during the closure.

authority: Secretary of State for the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

claims.s: Perenco UK Limited has submitted draft decommissioning programmes for the Trent jackets in the Southern North Sea.
Representations should be received by 31 August 2026.
The Trent jackets are about 50 km from Flamborough.
The Trent installations lie outside any Special Area of Conservation.
The Secretary of State proposes an order to stop up part of Cemetery Lane at Wymondham in South Norfolk.
Objections should be received by midnight on 31 July 2026.
The stopping up is to enable development permitted by Breckland Council.
Copies of the draft order can be inspected at Norwich Library.
South West Water is applying for a drought order that would allow it to restrict non-essential use of water in parts of Mid and East Devon.
Objections may be made in writing up to and including 13 October 2026.
The drought order would ban all domestic water use.
The application covers the whole of Cornwall.
The Secretary of State for Transport has confirmed Devon County Council's side roads order for the Cullompton Town Centre Relief Road.
A challenge to the order can be made to the High Court within 6 weeks of 7 July 2026.
The order was confirmed on 19 July 2026.
The order can be inspected at Cullompton Library.
Ardrossan Harbour Company Limited has applied for an order to transfer Ardrossan Harbour to Caledonian Maritime Assets Limited.
Objections can be made to the Scottish Ministers within 42 days of the date at the foot of the notice.
An environmental statement has been prepared for the order.
Objections should be sent to Inverclyde Council.
The Secretary of State has made an order stopping up part of Long Close Lane and a footpath off Hope Street in York.
A challenge can be made to the High Court within 6 weeks from 9 September 2026.
The stopping up is to enable development permitted by Leeds City Council.
Copies of the order cost £5.

authority: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
Secretary of State for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

claims.s: The Secretary of State made an order on 26 February 2026 reconstituting the Ouse and Derwent Internal Drainage Board.
The order reduces the number of elected members to 11.
The order increases the number of electoral divisions to 3.
The order can be challenged in the High Court within 3 months.
Serica Energy (UK) Limited has applied to the North Sea Transition Authority to build and use a pipeline from the Bruce CR Platform.
Representations should be sent by 6 March 2026.
Representations should be sent to the Scottish Ministers.
The application is for an onshore gas pipeline.
